steps.caption: Greedy isn't always right. Make 6 with coins [1, 3, 4] using as few coins as possible.
Greedy: take the biggest coin that fits (4). Left: 2.
Greedy: take the biggest coin that fits (1). Left: 1.
Greedy: take the biggest coin that fits (1). Left: 0.
Greedy used 3 coins, but 3 + 3 uses 2. Taking the 4 first looked best locally and ruined the rest. This needs dynamic programming (Module 12).
